tbesh_html:
1) kidneys
1a) of physical organ (lit.)
1b) of seat of emotion and affection (fig.)
1c) of sacrificial animals
2) (TWOT) reins

strongs_1890.strongs_def: a kidney (as an essential organ); figuratively, the mind (as the interior self)
strongs_1890.derivation: feminine of H3627 (כְּלִי) (only in the plural);
